content: Digital and Analog systems, logic level and pulse waveforms, elements of
digital logic, Functions of digital logic
Number System: Binary number system (addition, subtraction,
multiplication, Division), Octal and Hexadecimal Number system,
Conversion from binary to decimal, octal and hexadecimal and vice versa,
Representation of Signed Numbers.
Codes : BCD, XS-3, Gray Code ( with Conversion), Alphanumerical Code
Logic Gates: Positive and Negative logic, AND, OR , NOT, NAND, NOR,
X-OR Gate, X-NOR Gate ( all gates with symbol, working principal and
truth table), Conversion from Universal Gate to all other Gates,
Boolean Algebra & Mapping Methods for Simplification: Boolean
Algebra, Karnaugh Maps, Realizing Logic Function with Gates.
Combinational Circuits and its implementations, Arithmetic Circuits - Adders
and Subtractor, BCD Adder, Look-Ahead Carry Generator, Multiplier,
Magnitude comparator. Multiplexer and it’s application, Encoders,
Demultiplexers and Decoders and it’s application, Parity Generation and
Checking, Code Conversion.
Flip-flops: Latch and Flip-flop, S-R flip-flops, D flip flop, J-K flip flop,
Application of flip flops
Registers: Classification , Serial in serial-out, serial-in parallel-out, parallel-
in serial-out and parallel-in parallel out shift register
Counters: Asynchronous (ripple) 4-bit binary counter, BCD Counter,
Synchronous counters, UP/DOWN counter, Ring counters.
1.5 Introduction to Programmable Logic Devices, Programmable Logic Arrays

(PLA), Programmable Array Logic (PAL).
